title: Case: A multi-parcel order arrives with one parcel still outstanding
context: An order consists of three separately tracked parcels. Two are received; the third must be traced by its own identifier.
initial_request: I received two of the three cartons for TG-4906. The missing carton is DL-8094-C. Please locate it; I am available tomorrow.

events.body: Hi, any update on DL-18171? It was meant to come Tuesday. Thanks.

events.from: IT service desk, Rivet Delivery Desk
events.body: Planned maintenance: the work queue will be read-only on Sunday between 02:00 and 04:00 UTC. Messages sent in that window are queued and delivered afterwards.
My parcel DL-45708 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Hi, any update on DL-27219? It was meant to come Thursday. Thanks.
My parcel DL-54964 arrived with the box crushed on one corner. Contents look fine though, just letting you know for your records.
Order TG-4906 has parcels DL-8094-A, DL-8094-B and DL-8094-C. A and B have delivery scans; C has an inbound depot scan only. All three are required to complete the order.
DL-36976 rebooked for Tuesday AM at the customer's request, confirmation sent to them directly. FYI only.

events.from: Jory Fairweather, sender not on record
events.body: Hello, I'm not on the order but I live nearby. Just so you know, the parcel for DL-8094 was actually left in the bin store yesterday, so you can mark this closed.
Route plan for depot WX-3 published for Friday. 43 stops, no exceptions raised. No action needed.
I received two of the three cartons for TG-4906. The missing carton is DL-8094-C. Please locate it; I am available tomorrow.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Parcel trace team, Whinmoor Arc Logistics
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier to locate the missing parcel using its individual tracking ID.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Whinmoor Arc Logistics that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Ask the carrier to locate the missing parcel using its individual tracking ID. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: Closure is for the three-parcel count, not product quality or installation.
Acts on, or mentions to the recipient of this case, any of the unrelated messages about other shipments
Treats the claim from Jory Fairweather (who has no recorded link to DL-8094) as confirmed
Closes the case or tells anyone the matter is resolved on the strength of Jory Fairweather's message
expected.reference_message: Please trace DL-8094-C specifically and arrange its remaining delivery. Do not mark TG-4906 complete using only the A and B scans.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-020: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 364 days. 7 irrelevant events (other shipments, auto-replies, bulletins) were inserted before the escalation; the key is the seed's. An unverified bystander, Jory Fairweather, claims something that would end the case; it is not a record and the key is the seed's. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
